userStories.title: Pipeline ordering matches Section 9.4
acceptanceCriteria: run_weekly executes steps in the order: scan, cluster, pass 1 batched, pass 2 frontier on low-confidence, moments validation, selector, follow-up, render
Each step's outputs feed only the documented downstream steps
userStories.notes: run_weekly() added to praxis/orchestrator.py with 8 mockable step functions (_step_scan, _step_cluster, _step_pass1, _step_pass2, _step_validate_moments, _step_select_moments, _step_follow_up, _step_render). Pass1Output wraps results+low_confidence_session_ids so pass2 receives only IDs, never pass1 scores (spec 9.1). New tests in test_orchestrator.py monkeypatch each step and assert the call sequence equals the Section 9.4 order, and that each step receives only documented upstream outputs.

userStories.title: Persist weekly_digests row with snapshot_json
acceptanceCriteria: A weekly_digests row is written for the current week_iso with generated_at, trajectory_label, trajectory_headline, headline_moment_id, cost_total_usd, cost_baseline_usd, snapshot_json, and html_path
snapshot_json contains the full ProfileSnapshot for the week
Re-running on the same week is idempotent (UPSERT semantics)
userStories.notes: Added ProfileStore.save_weekly_digest / load_weekly_digest / count_weekly_digests with INSERT OR REPLACE on the week_iso PK. snapshot_json is asdict(ProfileSnapshot). run_weekly() now computes trajectory via extract_signals + assess_trajectory (off scanned sessions, not via a new pipeline step) and UPSERTs the digest row after render. WeeklyRunSummary gains trajectory/cost_total_usd/cost_baseline_usd/digest_persisted fields. cost_total_usd and cost_baseline_usd are wired through as None pending US-073. html_path is None until the render step starts writing files.
